jobs.prompt: Create a premium anatomical exercise illustration of an adult male performing DEAD BUG. Image 1 is a POSITION GUIDE from our original rig, not the final drawing style. Match its four poses and the 2 by 2 panel arrangement. Image 2 is ONLY the approved anatomical visual STYLE reference. Final rendering must be detailed realistic grayscale anatomical illustration, clean white background, subtle shadows; do not copy the crude line art appearance. Full opaque black shorts and a complete fitted black training T-shirt. Abdominals red; if covered by fabric use a red teaching overlay without removing cloth. TOP LEFT: lie flat on back, head left, feet right, arms straight up to ceiling, BOTH THIGHS VERTICAL above hips, BOTH SHINS HORIZONTAL, hips and knees each 90 degrees. TOP RIGHT: keep far arm vertical, extend NEAR arm overhead toward left; keep near thigh vertical with knee 90 degrees, extend FAR leg straight and low toward right. BOTTOM LEFT identical to top left. BOTTOM RIGHT: keep NEAR arm vertical, extend FAR arm overhead; keep FAR thigh vertical with bent knee, extend NEAR leg straight and low. Near arm pairs with far leg and vice versa. Preserve the head-left side view in every panel. Rest head and back on the floor, never a crunch. Feet must be off floor in every pose. Opposite working limbs must visibly alternate; use overlapping depth shading as in guide. Show entire body inside each panel with ample white margins. No text or arrows. No exposed garment-covered anatomy. Output four equally sized panels in a square 2x2 master.
